info.title: NEXA API
info.description: NEXA Workplace - internal social + communication platform. All /api/v1 endpoints except auth require `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

created.description: Whether this sign-in created the account

id_token.description: The ID token Google returned for this sign-in

nonce.description: The nonce sent in the authorization request; the token must carry it

link_token.description: From the ACCOUNT_LINK_REQUIRED error; valid for 10 minutes

slug.description: Derived from the name when omitted

token.description: Shown only once - share it with the invitee. Only its hash is stored.

headers.description: Send these unchanged; the body must be exactly `size` bytes

url.description: Download URL once the file is READY

content_type.description: Checked against the actual bytes when the upload completes

size.description: Exact size in bytes. The upload URL only accepts a body of this size.

avatar_url.description: Serves the picture to anyone (for tags) while it is your avatar

file_id.description: One of your READY uploads: a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP picture of at most 5 MB

content.description: null once the message is deleted

attachments.description: Empty once the message is deleted

url.description: Presigned download URL, valid for at least an hour; fetch the item again for a new one

content.description: May be empty when the message carries attachments

client_message_id.description: Generated by the client once per message and reused on retries, so a retry never creates a duplicate.

attachment_ids.description: Up to 10 of your own uploaded files with status READY, in display order

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may edit (UI hint)

can_delete.description: Whether the caller may delete (UI hint)

content.example: Chào mừng cả team đến với NEXA!

attachment_ids.description: Up to 10 of your own uploaded files with status READY, in display order
Replaces every attachment of the post

parent_id.description: Reply to this comment. A reply to a reply is attached to the thread root.

id.description: Id of the domain event that was audited

allOf.description: Latest person who caused it; null when they are gone

actors.description: Up to 3 most recent distinct actors

highlights.description: [start, end) of each matched word prefix within text (JavaScript offsets)

post.summary: Register a new account
post.description: The new user joins the default organization; its first member becomes OWNER. Also served under `/api` without the `/v1` segment (exam contract, ADR-010).

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description: Also served under `/api` without the `/v1` segment (exam contract, ADR-010).

post.summary: Sign in with a Google ID token
post.description: The token must be issued for this server's GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and carry the nonce of the authorization request. A new email gets an account (joining the default organization). If the email already has an account, answers 409 ACCOUNT_LINK_REQUIRED with a `link_token`: confirm that account's password with /auth/oauth/link to connect Google. 404 SSO_NOT_CONFIGURED when Google sign-in is off.

post.summary: Connect Google to an existing account by confirming its password
Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair
post.description: The refresh token is rotated: the old one stops working. Replaying an already-used token revokes the whole session.

post.summary: End the session a refresh token belongs to
Change password and sign out all other sessions

post.description: Reserves the file and returns a presigned PUT URL. Send the bytes straight to that URL with the returned headers (the body must be exactly `size` bytes), then call `complete`.
